page.notes: The first line of the index opens at the left edge and is partly cut off by the scan edge; the printed letters at the start are read as shown. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. Several entries are blurred or overlapped by ink: "Columbarum verna feturα" (the final letter is doubtful), "Coersetudinis" (the opening capital is a swash overlapping the following letters, read as "Co" + "ersetudinis"; a probable print form is "Consuetudinis"), "Colostra" and "Continia" (the initial letters are doubtful), "Cibus bonus in ventre" (the word "ventre" is partly obscured), "Ciborum pituitoforum immoderatus usus" (the second word is partly obscured), and "Coctura" (the first letter is doubtful). Several page numbers are blurred and may be misread, notably "375. 535", "348", "390", and "65". No page number is printed on this page.
